coverage_scope.exclusion: pair excluded from the exposure and recorded; no renormalization, no rate invention

orbital_source.role: author-maintained orbital constants and nonrelativistic BEB formula; valence only; not branching

outer3_band.rate: dataset arithmetic: sum_i weight_i S_i/(t+u+1)[Q ln t/2 (1-1/t^2)+(2-Q)(1-1/t-ln t/(t+1))]

source.role: Primary theoretical application of high-energy single-vacancy branching, Eqs27-30; empirical lineage Tan etal ChemPhys29,299(1978), DOI10.1016/0301-0104(78)85080-0. Proton collision dynamics are NOT imported as electron-impact rates.

provisional_band.formula: Kim, Santos & Parente, Phys. Rev. A 62, 052710 (2000), RBEB with alpha^4 = (2R/mc^2)^2, times per-orbital parent weights
validation_targets_not_in_dataset: Schutten et al., J. Chem. Phys. 44, 3924 (1966), total ionization 0.1-20 keV
Rieke & Prepejchal, Phys. Rev. A 6, 1507 (1972), total ionization 0.1-2.7 MeV

policy.refusal_rule: refuse iff unbounded-and-not-admitted, or (events_upper > event limit AND physical_upper*(1-f) > f*applied_physical); evaluated per exposure and cumulatively

upper_bound.envelope: max of the two bracketing tabulated values; sigma_parent <= sigma_inelastic

total_ionization_vs_measured.note: Munoz 2007 Table I is a gross (ion-current, charge-weighted) observable including O 1s and multiple ionization; the four-orbital BEB/RBEB total is a counting valence cross section.
